messages:
sam: Noticed a spike of 401s from our OIDC token endpoint after last night's KMS rotation. SCIM syncs failing with downstream 403s. Anyone change the rotation script?

lee: Rotation ran at 2026-04-10T23:30Z. I updated the automation to standardize key policies to the org-template. I thought service exceptions were preserved via tags.

pat: Logs show KMS Sign access denied for the oidc-client role. Snippet:
```
2026-04-10T23:46:05Z ERROR oidc: token_exchange tenant=stellar status=401 err=invalid_client
2026-04-10T23:46:05Z ERROR kms: Sign failed key=alias/oidc-signing principal=arn:aws:iam::123456:role/oidc-client error=AccessDeniedException
```

oncall-rina: I'm oncall; I can create an emergency grant to restore Sign for the oidc-client role and restart the pods if we want to triage quickly. That will temporarily bypass the key policy.

security-bot: Change detected: key alias "oidc-signing-key" rotated 2026-04-10T23:30Z. Policy diff removed Sid "AllowOIDCClientSign" which previously allowed kms:Sign to arn:aws:iam::123456:role/oidc-client. Risk flagged high for auth flows.

sam: Please create the grant and restart. Also capture CloudTrail events and the policy diff for compliance artifacts.

lee: creating PR to adjust rotation automation to keep service-exceptions based on tag "service:oauth". Will also add a dry-run that simulates kms:Sign and kms:Decrypt via `rcli iam simulate`.

pat: Restarted oidc-client; token exchange success rates improving. Backfills for failed SCIM jobs are running. So far ~16 tenants affected during the 23:30-23:52 window. No evidence of unauthorized actions.

oncall-rina: Emergency grant created at 2026-04-10T23:55Z (AUDIT-ID: AUD-1012). I'll remove it once rotation automation is fixed and a stable key policy deployed.

compliance-ana: Please attach the CloudTrail + audit entry to INC-7812. We need tenant lists and timestamps for the compliance packet.

pat: I'll produce the tenant impact list and upload to the incident doc. Early check: all failures were retries or blocked by token exchange, no deprovisions completed unexpectedly.

lee: Action items: update rotation job (owner: lee), add post-rotate smoke test for token exchange (owner: lee), produce tenant impact list (owner: pat), remove emergency grant after fix (owner: oncall-rina), add alert for kms AccessDenied for oauth principals (owner: sam).

sam: Also add a unit test to rotation tooling that asserts any principal with tag service:oauth retains kms:Sign in the generated policy. And add runtime metric `kms_acl_denied{principal="oidc-client"}`.

security-bot: Recommend severity: configuration -> medium. Suggest runbook update: include a pre-rotate simulation step and post-rotate smoke.

lee: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/rotation/PR-789. Adding tests and dry-run.

sam: Thanks all. Schedule 30m postmortem tomorrow. Closing the emergency path once audit artifacts collected. :white_check_mark:
